response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep systems thinking, and exposure to AI-agent tooling, but lacks clear evidence of distributed systems ownership at scale, Python mastery, or direct experience with AI-native code generation workflows — key requirements for this staff-level role.
strengths: Proven experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq
Extensive full-stack and systems-level coding across languages including TypeScript, DLang, and Node.js
Strong operational and open-source contributions with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and incident-ready tooling
concerns: No explicit demonstration of Python mastery or high-throughput distributed system design
Limited evidence of technical strategy leadership or cross-functional stakeholder alignment at staff level
AI exposure is tangential; no clear track record of reviewing/extending AI-generated code as primary workflow
